schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE pazienti (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_nascita DATE NOT NULL,
    sesso CHAR(1) NOT NULL CHECK (sesso IN ('M', 'F')),
    indirizzo TEXT,
    telefono TEXT,
    email TEXT UNIQUE,
    visite INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (visite >= 0)
);

query:
WITH RECURSIVE visite_cumulative AS (
    SELECT id, nome, cognome, visite, visite AS cumulativo
    FROM pazienti
    WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM pazienti)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.id, p.nome, p.cognome, p.visite, p.visite + vc.cumulativo
    FROM pazienti p
    JOIN visite_cumulative vc ON p.id = vc.id + 1
),
statistiche AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS totale_pazienti,
        SUM(visite) AS totale_visite,
        AVG(visite) AS media_visite,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sesso = 'M') AS maschi,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sesso = 'F') AS femmine,
        SUM(CASE WHEN visite > 0 THEN visite ELSE 0 END) AS visite_effettive
    FROM pazienti
),
pazienti_ranks AS (
    SELECT
        p.id, p.nome, p.cognome, p.sesso, p.visite,
        DATE_PART('year', AGE(p.data_nascita)) AS eta,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.visite DESC) AS rank_visite,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.sesso ORDER BY p.visite DESC) AS row_sesso
    FROM pazienti p
    JOIN visite_cumulative vc ON p.id = vc.id
),
pazienti_stessi_visite AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p1.id, p1.nome, p1.cognome, p1.visite
    FROM pazienti p1
    JOIN pazienti p2 ON p1.visite = p2.visite AND p1.id != p2.id
),
pazienti_senza_visite AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.nome, p.cognome
    FROM pazienti p
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pazienti p2
        WHERE p2.id = p.id AND p2.visite > 0
    )
),
gruppi_sesso AS (
    SELECT sesso, COUNT(*) AS conteggio, AVG(visite) AS media_visite
    FROM pazienti
    GROUP BY sesso
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
)
SELECT
    'GRUPPO_SESSO' AS categoria,
    gs.sesso::TEXT AS etichetta,
    gs.conteggio AS valore_num,
    ROUND(gs.media_visite, 2) AS valore_dec,
    s.totale_pazienti,
    NULL::INT AS rank_val
FROM gruppi_sesso gs
CROSS JOIN statistiche s
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'TOP_VISITE' AS categoria,
    pr.nome || ' ' || pr.cognome AS etichetta,
    pr.visite AS valore_num,
    pr.eta::NUMERIC AS valore_dec,
    s.totale_pazienti,
    pr.rank_visite AS rank_val
FROM pazienti_ranks pr
CROSS JOIN statistiche s
WHERE pr.rank_visite <= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'SENZA_VISITE' AS categoria,
    ps.nome || ' ' || ps.cognome AS etichetta,
    0 AS valore_num,
    NULL::NUMERIC AS valore_dec,
    s.totale_pazienti,
    NULL::INT AS rank_val
FROM pazienti_senza_visite ps
CROSS JOIN statistiche s
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'DOPPIO_VISITE' AS categoria,
    psv.nome || ' ' || psv.cognome AS etichetta,
    psv.visite AS valore_num,
    NULL::NUMERIC AS valore_dec,
    s.totale_pazienti,
    NULL::INT AS rank_val
FROM pazienti_stessi_visite psv
CROSS JOIN statistiche s
ORDER BY categoria, valore_num DESC
LIMIT 10;
